_network_type: SNN autoencoder (recurrent/LSNN pre-processor with spiking neurons)
_architecture_summary: Encoder: input→LSNN(64)→Linear(32)→latent z. Decoder: z→Linear(64)→LSNN(64)→Linear(output)→reconstruct. LSNN: Leaky with adaptive threshold a[t]. Surrogate: exponential.
_loss_function: Spike-time loss (first spike latency decoding) + spike regularization
_preprocessing: Window 256 (1s@256Hz), encodings: direct, Poisson, latency. v_th sweep [0.5,1.0,1.5], α decay sweep [0.8,0.9,0.99].
_total_runs_breakdown: 81 total = 3 encodings × 3 v_th × 3 α × 3 repeats (seeds 42,43,44). Full hyperparameter sweep for recurrent LSNN architecture.
_dataset_config: 500 train, 100 val (FSDD). 100 epochs max, early stop patience 20, lr 0.001 (weights), 0.0001 (SNN params), batch size 1.
_comment: SNN-AE recurrent: 81 runs (3 enc × 3 v_th × 3 α × 3 repeats). SNN+LSNN+Leaky+adaptive+spike-time. 500/100 data. Est. ~4 hrs.
